newsitem.title: CANADA: Nortel wins US$150 mln order from Ionica.
newsitem.headline: Nortel wins US$150 mln order from Ionica.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Thursday it won orders worth US$150 million from privately held telecommunications carrier Ionica for Proximity I fixed radio access network equipment and services.
The equipment is slated for delivery in the next 18 months.
The Proximity I system was developed in conjunction with Ionica. It will form the foundation of a new telephone service launched in Britain last May.
Ionica said the purchase would allow it to continue rolling out its network and sign on new customers in 1997.
The Proximity line of wireless access products uses radio instead of copper cable to provide a telephone connection.
